hero.title: How the AI Finance Agent works
hero.lede: Follow the workflow from raw transactions to a faster, more accurate month-end close, step by step.
intro.title: Four steps from data to decision
intro.body: The Accounting Agent and Finance Agent work together across your ledger. Here is what happens at each stage, and what you get back.
item-1.title: Capture and clean
item-1.body: The Accounting Agent updates transactions, combines data from across the business, and flags inconsistencies automatically.
item-2.title: Reconcile and categorize
item-2.body: Bookkeeping tasks that used to take hours are handled in the background, so the ledger stays current.
item-3.title: Summarize and monitor
item-3.body: The Finance Agent delivers monthly financial summaries, budget insights, and ongoing performance monitoring.
item-4.title: Close with confidence
item-4.body: Month-end close arrives faster with accuracy you can count on, freeing the team for higher-value analysis.
